book.name: DHÄWU ŊURRU'‐ŊURRUŊUWALAŊUWUY
book.title: JUDGES Ḻakarama yukurra ŋurru'‐ŋurruŋunha yolŋu'‐yulŋunha Godkuŋu nherraṉarawuynha walŋakunharawu nhanukalayŋuwu yolŋu'‐yulŋuwu

content: Ga maṉḏanydja Dipuranydja ga Baraktja wirrkina dhika goŋmirriyina, bala maṉḏa yukurrana wokthurrunanydja Garraywuna, buku‐wekaŋalana yukurrana ŋanya, ga miyamara yukurrana maṉḏa manikaykurruna, balanyarana gam'.

content.text: Ŋunhi ŋuli yolŋu'‐yulŋu wekanharamirri walalawuynha walala nhanukala,
bala ŋayinydja ŋuli guŋga'yunna walalanha yana.
Dharpuŋala ŋayinydja ŋanya Djitjuranha, bala ŋayi rakunydhinana.
Garray, bukmaknha ŋunhi miriŋunha walalanha buŋana yana rewal'yurrana,
yurru ŋunhinydja walala ŋunhi walala yukurra nhuŋu märr‐ŋamathirri,
Walalanydja yukurra yurru baḏayala'na milkuma wiripu‐guḻku'wuna,
bitjana dhuwala walu ya' walma marrtji ŋuli,

content: Bala yukurrana Yitjuralpuyŋunydja nhinana miṯtji marimiriwnha märr‐weyinnha, 40 dhuŋgarranydja ŋupara, ga yana liŋgu ga Dipura rakunydhina.
